{{Top|leg}}
A '''sky-sailor''' was the term given to [[Exocron]] citizens who made their living working on the various [[sky transport]]s and other repulsorlift powered vehicles that plied the planet's airlanes. The term may have also been applied to members of the [[Exocron Airfleet]].
